audio.text: Weren't the tickets supposed to go on sale at noon?

options: I bought a sweater on sale at noon.
Yes, I'm supposed to be there at noon.
The theater seats about two hundred people.
They pushed it back because the website crashed.

why.en: Indirect answer: the sale was moved, and here is why. A repeats "on sale" and "noon"; B says "Yes" about a different plan; C gives an unrelated fact.
why.tr: Dolaylı cevap: satış ertelenmiş ve nedeni bu. A "on sale" ve "noon" ifadelerini tekrar ediyor; B başka bir plan için "Yes" diyor; C ilgisiz bir bilgi veriyor.
why.es: Respuesta indirecta: la venta se aplazó, y este es el motivo. A repite "on sale" y "noon"; B dice "Yes" sobre otro plan; C da un dato que no viene al caso.
